neighbours.label: Entitlement and justification: having the right to act (reserves the right, justified in, rightfully); other senses of ' right' and ' reserve' and plain statements stay quiet
fire: The bank reserves the right to refuse any application.
We reserve the right to change these terms without notice.
The judge was justified in rejecting the appeal.
She was rightfully proud of her team's work.
The publisher reserves the right to edit all letters.
The tribunal held that the employer was justified in dismissing him.
Each citizen has the right to petition the court.
They were rightly angry about the broken promise.
quiet: The bank refused the application on Monday morning.
We changed these terms last week after the meeting.
The judge rejected the appeal without comment.
She looked at the right side of her team's chart.
The publisher edits all the letters by hand.
The tribunal met in the hall where the employer worked.
Each citizen can reserve a seat at the court.
They walked off to the right after the broken gate.
